name: Misaki (Osaka, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Misaki town emblem in navy: a disc with a notch at the top and a white keyhole-shaped device.
history: Municipal flag of Misaki, a town in Osaka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 28 December 1963.

features.role: Misaki town emblem — a disc with a notch at the top and a white keyhole-shaped device
